page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes in the right margin (Aeneid reference "Æneid. 4.", "Senes.", "Herc. fur."); running head at top; signature "A 3" at foot.

main_text.p: ient; atque alia ipsius farina (neque vero Æneid. 4. potes ignorare à quibus ista dicantur, defendantur divulgentur) jam Te no Mani chaorum vesaniam æquare, sed etiam multis-partibus superare. Hem accusatione capitalem! Egone vero à te, Berti, quē christianum, quem amicum, quem fratrem æstimabam, tantorum facinorum ac tam atrocium crimina susciperem? Sane quidem non tam à gravi & moderato theologo hæc tam falsæ, tamque iniquæ ac virulentæ criminationes oblatæ videntur, quàm ab Hercule quodam furente, aut à Furiis ipsis, & Eumenidum aliqua aut furibunda Didone, quæ Senes. Herc. fur.
main_text.l: Savit inops animi, totamque infensa per urbem
Thyas, ubi audito stimulant trieterica Baccho
main_text.p: Itaque tibi, obsecro te, quid est, mi Berti? Quis tibi morbus est in pectore, qui

page.notes: Right margin notes are partly faint; the verse lines are set in italic. Lines of the Aeneid quotation and the marginal "Senes." and "Herc. fur." reading are uncertain. Catchword/line ending "ate" is a fragment of the next word; "ate" at the foot is partly cut off.
